svg.aria-label: NEON ARENA: A bloom-soaked geometry shooter. Multi-stage boss fights, bullet hells, arcade pace. CRT LOOK: One hand-written WGSL shader: scanlines, vignette, barrel distortion. A quality tier per platform. RUNS ANYWHERE: Native on Vulkan, Metal or DirectX 12. In the browser via WASM. Keyboard only
